# Release notes

Version 2.3 adds export to CSV and fixes two crashes.

<!-- reviewer: remember to update the changelog before tagging -->

## Changes

- Export to CSV from the reports page.
- Fixed a crash when a filter was empty.

```sh
alixai export --format csv > report.csv
```

## Compatibility

| Platform | Supported | Notes          |
|----------|-----------|----------------|
| Linux    | yes       | amd64 and arm64 |
| Windows  | yes       | service mode   |
| macOS    | yes       | arm64 only     |
